question: Which of the following statements is FALSE regarding the staging of pancreatic cancer?

options.opa: Local staging can be performed with MRI and CT.
options.opb: Arterial tumor invasion is an unresectability criterion.
options.opc: Focal infiltration of the superior mesenteric vein is not a contraindication to surgery.
options.opd: The preoperative biopsy of pancreatic tumors is usually necessary to decide the surgical treatment.
